name: v91_untuned
_why: The 17 search parameters no tune has touched: hand-set since they were
written. Time management stays out (tune it against the pool, METHODOLOGY 6)
and razoring stays out (the batch tune already moved it to 500, effectively off).
tools/seedcheck_spsa.sh copies this into runs/spsa/v91_untuned/config.json and
points net at whichever net won the cosine run. This file keeps the v9.1 net so
it is safe to run as it stands.
c is at least 1.5 on small integers: c_k decays to c/2.36 by iteration 5000, and
below 0.5 both perturbations round to the same value and the step is pure noise.
